_comment: The branch-protection configuration the repository intends to run under, recorded by reading the live API on the date above. scripts/check_branch_protection.py compares this against the live configuration and reports drift. It is a log because the protection settings are not in version control and have already been relaxed temporarily to merge a PR — a relaxed setting that is not restored is indistinguishable from a policy change unless the intended state is written down.
notes: reviews=1 with enforce_admins=true means a single maintainer cannot merge without a second approval; the merge ritual therefore relaxes required_approving_review_count to 0 and restores it immediately afterwards.
strict=true means the branch must be up to date with main before merging, so a PR that passed CI against an older base has to be updated before it can land.
The five required contexts include coverage and frontend-coverage from coverage.yml; renaming a job there silently removes it from the required set unless this file is updated too.
